tools.name: check_experience
tools.description: Whether THIS SITE publishes anything evidencing a topic. Returns supported, partial, not_found, or not_on_this_page when the page does not carry the career record. not_found is a statement about what is published, never about Rafe.

tools.name: get_page_facts
tools.description: The structured facts of the page currently open — the same data behind its schema.org markup. Use this instead of reading the DOM.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Every published case study — client, sector, what Rafe did, the lead outcome and the URL. Optionally filtered by sector or client.

tools.name: search_writing
tools.description: Search Rafe Blandford's published writing by title, excerpt and tag. Returns URLs to read. A blank query returns the most recent.
